messages:
elaine: Opening PR #4502 with a short migration appendix and refreshed SDK snippets (Py/TS). Hoping to land in the 16:00 PT docs slot. reviewers?
omar: Happy to review. Please confirm glossary terms (workspace vs tenant) and avoid calling SDK users 'customers' — use 'developers' instead.
deepa: I'll check code. Reminder: no inline keys in snippets, use `Client.from_env()` or env loader. Prefer generator-style streaming examples.
stylebot: Style-check: two hits for the word 'simple' (recommend 'straightforward' or more specific guidance). Passive voice detected in step 2 of migration. Suggest changing imperatives to softer phrasing where appropriate.
elaine: Thanks — swapped tenant->workspace, replaced inline keys, switched streaming samples to generator loops. Reworded step 2 to active voice and softened the checklist language. Pushed changes.
preview-bot: Preview build failed: LinkCheckError -> migration.md anchor '#routing-fallbacks' unresolved. See preview logs.
elaine: Fixing the anchor name (I renamed header earlier, missed link). Pushing hotfix now.
preview-bot: Preview ready: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/PR-4502 7 please sanity-check tables, code blocks, and tone.
deepa: Code pass: generator streaming example looks good. tiny nit: include a one-line comment about backpressure in the snippet. Also suggest logging error.code instead of printing full exception.
omar: Tone pass: replaced remaining imperative sentences with gentler phrasing ("You can run" vs "Run"). Replaced both 'simple' instances with 'straightforward' and clarified one ambiguous sentence. Left punctuation nit in a list item.
ci-bot: Docs build succeeded 7 0 warnings.
stylebot: Final style-check passed.
deepa: Approving from examples side; left one optional suggestion on error handling.
omar: Approved from docs side.
elaine: Thanks all 7 merging at 16:10 PT (10-min buffer).
ci-bot: Merged PR #4502 7 congrats!
